messages:

Subject: AtlasCloud MSA and DPA - subvendor notice and initial redlines

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, AtlasCloud needs to add a downstream subcontractor (EdgeTier) to provide logging and backup services tied to the Order Form. Per our procurement requirements we're sending over: (1) the current MSA with our redlines, and (2) an updated DPA.

Key asks from Atlas:
- Confirmation that Redwood accepts subprocessor flow-downs for the specific service scope listed on p.3 of the Order Form.
- Agreement on audit cadence (Atlas prefers annual SOC or quarterly evidence).
- Minor tweaks to the DPA data retention table (we reduced retention for ephemeral logs).

Attachments: Atlas_MSA_redline_20250727.docx, Atlas_DPA_v2.pdf

Can you loop in your legal and procurement team and let us know the earliest time to resolve redlines? We're targetting final counters by end of next week to meet our January rollout.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Holt
Vendor Partnerships
AtlasCloud

Subject: Re: AtlasCloud MSA and DPA - subvendor notice and initial redlines

Sam — thanks for the materials. I reviewed the attachments briefly and am looping in Kimberly and Connor to triage the legal and procurement sides. High level response:

- We are open to approving EdgeTier as a subprocessor provided the flow-down scope is tightly scoped to logging/backup and we get the DPA changes and evidence we need.
- Audit cadence: we normally accept annual SOC 2 + on-demand evidence for sensitive requests, but Kimberly will confirm whether we can meet Atlas's quarterly ask or propose mitigations.
- I've put a short internal timeline below and proposed a sync: Wed 07/30 10:00 PT for a 30-min call (legal + procurement + Atlas). Please confirm availability.

Internal next steps (action owners):
- Kimberly: legal redline review and proposed alternative language for the subcontractor flow-down (due Tue EOD).
- Connor: procurement to validate third-party risk intake and escalate any non-standard controls (due Tue EOD).
- Marissa: operations/solutions to validate the Order Form scope and whether EdgeTier's role is limited to non-PII logs (due Wed morning).

Sam — can Atlas confirm whether EdgeTier will have any persistent access to customer PII? If no, that simplifies the DPA conversation.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasCloud MSA and DPA - subvendor notice and initial redlines

Team — I reviewed Atlas's MSA redlines and the DPA. High-level notes:

1) Subprocessor flow-down: Their proposed clause is broad and would allow further downstream delegation without prior notice. We should push for either:
   - a specific list of permitted subprocessor activities (logging, ephemeral backup), or
   - a requirement that Atlas provide 30 days' notice + right to object for any additional subprocessor beyond EdgeTier.

2) Audit cadence: Atlas's quarterly evidence ask is not generally feasible. Proposed compromise:
   - Accept annual SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) plus an on-demand targeted evidence review limited to the specific controls for logging/backup, with a defined SLT for responses (10 business days).

3) DPA retention: The retention table change looks fine as long as the retention for customer logs is no longer than 90 days for ephemeral stacks. Need Atlas to confirm technical controls (encryption, access logs).

4) Escrow / liability carveouts: Their redline reduces our ability to flow through limited liability to subvendors. We can accept subprocessor use only if Atlas retains primary liability for subprocessor failures and provides indemnification for breaches resulting from EdgeTier.

I'll attach a short suggested redline doc with replacement language for the flow-down clause and the audit/indemnity paragraphs. Posting as: redline_summary.xlsx (see attached).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Holt <sam.holt@atlascloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@atlascloud.com>, Legal Ops <legal@atlascloud.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasCloud MSA and DPA - subvendor notice and initial redlines

Kimberly / Logan,

Thanks for the clear feedback. Quick responses to the items above:

- EdgeTier access: confirmed — EdgeTier will not have persistent access to customer PII. Access is limited to ephemeral log ingestion and managed backups.
- Audit cadence: Atlas can accept the proposed compromise: annual SOC 2 Type II plus on-demand targeted evidence with a 10-business-day SLT. We will add contractual language acknowledging the SLT.
- Indemnity: Atlas is comfortable retaining primary liability for EdgeTier actions and will add an express indemnity paragraph for breaches caused by subprocessor negligence.

We updated the DPA and re-attached Atlas_DPA_v2.pdf which includes the retention adjustments and the new indemnity language. We also included a brief implementation note about encryption-at-rest for logs.

Action: Can Redwood share the proposed replacement language for flow-down and the final Order Form scope by EOD so Atlas can prepare counters and DocuSign?

Sam

- Marissa confirmed EdgeTier's role is logging/backup-only and no customer PII access; Connor signed off on procurement checklist with a minor control caveat (on-demand evidence must be provisionable in 10 business days).
- I've generated a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign stub for execution: https://www.docusign.com/secure/embeddedSigning/abc123-stub (Atlas to confirm counters by Mon 08/04).

Proposed meeting: Wed 07/30 10:00 PT — I see everyone is available; Kimberly, Connor, Marissa please join to walk the replacement clause and the DPA changes. Sam / Atlas please share the final EdgeTier SOC-2 summary beforehand (if available).

Thanks all — I'll hold the slot and send a calendar invite with the meeting doc.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
